analyzed_vuln.description: Heap-use-after-free is caused by GC marking traversing stale array element pointers in gc_mark_children() (MRB_TT_ARRAY/MRB_TT_STRUCT case). It reads ARY_PTR(a) and iterates len elements, calling mrb_gc_mark_value on entries that can reference objects from a heap page already freed during sweeping. The crash manifests in mrb_gc_mark() when it dereferences a freed RBasic pointer (is_white(obj) read). Root issue is unsafe/stale references retained in array storage that GC later trusts during mark traversal.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Via mruby_fuzzer, attacker-controlled Ruby source creates malformed object graph/state (notably heavy array/string/index mutation patterns in the PoC), then triggers GC (explicitly with GC.start in the payload and/or implicit full GC during VM execution). During incremental/full GC, sweep frees a heap page (incremental_sweep_phase -> mrb_free(page)); later marking walks array contents in gc_mark_children and passes a dangling element pointer to mrb_gc_mark, producing UAF read. Trigger requires crafting script state so an array slot (or struct-backed array slot) still contains a pointer to an object whose page was swept/freed before that slot is safely updated/cleared.
